description: This file defines the IStreamSubscriptionObserver interface in the Orleans.Streams.Core namespace, which includes a method for handling new or resumed stream subscriptions in grains.

classes.name: IStreamSubscriptionObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing stream subscription events, notifying grains of new or resumed subscriptions.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Method called when a grain receives a message for a stream it has not yet explicitly subscribed to or resumed.
